trajectory_source: NOAA GDP six-hour interpolated positions within preserved HYCOM time support, from 2014-03-08
interpretation: Independent implementation replay for the preserved HYCOM field. Starts outside the field's declared time support are skipped before counting attempts. Errors are conditioned on 184 complete trajectories; 16 spatial missing-value terminations are reported separately. The survivor errors cannot be interpreted as unconditional 30-day forecast accuracy.
